name: qualitrack
description: QualiTrack: centro de control de SQA para proyectos de software (Calidad de Software, SQA26).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w apps/api && npm run test:coverage -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
